# `rivermile`

## Overview

This package provides tools for calculating river miles of monitoring
locations along rivers and streams.

## Installation

You can install the `rivermile` package from GitHub using:

``` r

devtools::install_github("flowwest/rivermile")
```

### Example Usage

``` r

?rivermile::find_nearest_river_miles()
```

This function takes an `sf` object containing point locations (e.g.,
sampling points) and finds the nearest river mile for each point. If a
location is outside of the bounds of the processed data, an `NA` is
returned.

``` r

river_miles <- rivermile::find_nearest_river_miles(points_sp_df)
```

Use the `rivermile` package to get consistent geometries:

``` r

rivermile::all_klamath_rivers_line
rivermile::klamath_hucs
```

### Limitations

The package is currently only set up to process rivers of interest in
the Klamath River watershed HUC6 180102, which includes: Blue Creek,
Bogus Creek, Clear Creek, Indian Creek, Jenny Creek, Klamath River, Link
River, Lost River, Salmon River, Scott River, Shasta River, Sprague
River, Trinity River, Williamson River, Wood River, Camp Creek, Fall
Creek, Scotch Creek, Shovel Creek, and Spencer Creek.

If a point is outside of this range, an NA is returned.

# Package index

## Core Functions

Utilities for matching spatial points to river miles

- [`assign_sub_basin()`](https://github.com/flowwest/rivermile/reference/assign_sub_basin.md)
  : Assign Sub Basin
- [`extract_waterbody()`](https://github.com/flowwest/rivermile/reference/extract_waterbody.md)
  : Extract and Clean Waterbody Names from Text Strings
- [`extract_waterbody_short()`](https://github.com/flowwest/rivermile/reference/extract_waterbody_short.md)
  : Extract Simplified Waterbody Names
- [`find_nearest_river_miles()`](https://github.com/flowwest/rivermile/reference/find_nearest_river_miles.md)
  : Find Nearest River Miles
- [`gage_data_format()`](https://github.com/flowwest/rivermile/reference/gage_data_format.md)
  : Format and Filter Gage Data for Spatial Analysis
- [`get_nearest_river_mile_pt()`](https://github.com/flowwest/rivermile/reference/get_nearest_river_mile_pt.md)
  : Get Nearest River Mile Point
- [`get_river_miles()`](https://github.com/flowwest/rivermile/reference/get_river_miles.md)
  : Get river miles
- [`load_river_mile_data()`](https://github.com/flowwest/rivermile/reference/load_river_mile_data.md)
  : Load River Mile Data from the \`rivermile\` Package

## Datasets

Spatial layers included with the package

- [`all_klamath_rivers_line`](https://github.com/flowwest/rivermile/reference/all_klamath_rivers_line.md)
  : All Klamath River Lines
- [`klamath_hucs`](https://github.com/flowwest/rivermile/reference/klamath_hucs.md)
  : Klamath River HUCs
- [`klamath_lakes`](https://github.com/flowwest/rivermile/reference/klamath_lakes.md)
  : Klamath Basin lake and reservoir boundaries
- [`klamath_refuges`](https://github.com/flowwest/rivermile/reference/klamath_refuges.md)
  : Klamath Basin National Wildlife Refuge Complex boundaries
- [`nhd_catchments`](https://github.com/flowwest/rivermile/reference/nhd_catchments.md)
  : NHD Catchments
- [`processed_nhd`](https://github.com/flowwest/rivermile/reference/processed_nhd.md)
  : NHD Flowlines
